title: Command only works on this session's branch; a fresh session can publish a stale memory over the live one
detail: origin/main has no projects/constellation, no update-constellations skill and no CLAUDE.md trigger (git ls-tree origin/main; merge-base --is-ancestor 5808b71 origin/main -> notmerged). Sessions start on new claude/* branches, so a fresh session either lacks the skill (DoE 5 fails) or reads an older mind.json from its own tree, publishes it, and the changed stamp wipes the browser copies too: the earlier update's stars disappear from the live site. Fix: (a) REQUEST the Owner's go-ahead to merge to main; (b) at publish, also copy src/memories/<name>.json raw to gh-pages constellation/memories/<name>.json; step 1 starts with git fetch origin gh-pages and reads that file, and if it has stars or a newer max(updated) than the local file, start from it (or stop and say so).

title: Personal memory measured against the generic seed: wrong welcome-back count, and Reset to seed makes ?memory=mind open the seed until the file changes
detail: seedIds/seedDoc are always the bundled seed. Probe: browser copy of mind plus 1 hand star -> toast 'Welcome back. 38 lights. The 38 you stored are where you left them.' (should be 1). Reset dialog says 'Your 37 stored things will be gone'; after Replace and reload, ?memory=mind shows 88 lights in the cook lens with 'Welcome back' (the seed sits in the mind slot under a matching stamp). Fix: when personal, pass the file doc as the baseline (new App(graph, renderer, new Set(fileDoc.nodes ids), fileDoc, ...)) and label the menu item 'Reset to the saved file'.

title: Unknown ?memory= name says 'the seed is shown' but opens the main saved memory
detail: With a saved main memory (38 lights incl. a marker), ?memory=nope shows 'There's no memory called nope here, so the seed is shown.' next to 'Welcome back. 38 lights', and the marker star is present. The main key is not overwritten (DoE 3 holds), but the notice is false; README:45 says 'open as normal'. If the main copy is also unreadable, the later note at :119 overwrites this one and the name problem is never shown. Fix: word it 'so your usual memory is shown' (seed when there is no autosave), and append rather than overwrite note at :119.

title: A new memory file silently discards stars the Owner added in the browser
detail: On a stamp change the saved copy is removed with no notice and no backup (probe C: hand star gone, key removed, only the usual hint toast). Replacing is the brief's intent (DoE 2), but every other destructive replace in this app confirms or keeps a copy aside (F-003, F-004). Fix: before removeItem, if the saved copy has node ids not in the file, move it to <saveKey>.previous and toast 'Your memory was updated. N stars you added here were replaced.' with a Download action; mention this once in SKILL.md step 5.

title: U-memories tests pass a disconnected island, duplicate labels and over-long labels
detail: Mutation runs on a scratch copy: an isolated star, a dangling relation, a long value or facet, an unknown lens, bad JSON or no files all fail (good). These pass: two new stars linked only to each other (the test title says 'one connected sky'), a duplicate label (findByLabel/search pick one), a 60-char label (the skill caps labels at 32). Fix: BFS from the first node over relationsOf and assert every node is reached; assert labels are unique case-insensitively and are 32 characters or less.

title: Publish step: the Hearthwake force-push wipes /constellation/ silently, and a rejected push has no recovery
detail: origin/hearthwake .github/workflows/build.yml:44-49 does git init in site/ and push -f gh-pages, so any hearthwake push deletes the Owner's live link until the next update; the skill only reports it afterwards. If that push lands between fetch and push, 'git push origin HEAD:gh-pages' is rejected as non-fast-forward and the skill only says to retry network errors. Fix: on rejection, re-fetch gh-pages, recreate the worktree, recopy dist, push again; REQUEST the Owner's go-ahead to change the workflow to check out gh-pages and copy site/ over it, keeping other folders.

evidence: Owner approved (AskUserQuestion 2026-11-23): merge to main and save each update to main. Skill step 1 now fetches+merges origin/main before reading the memory; step 5 pushes the memory to main (fast-forward, never force). This mission's work is fast-forwarded to main at delivery.
main.ts: when personal, the baseline (seedIds/Reset doc) is the memory file. e2e [M3-3]: file + 1 hand star → 'Welcome back. 38 lights. The 1 you stored is where you left it.'

main.ts: notice now 'There's no memory called "nope" here, so your usual memory is shown.' in its own toast (no longer overwritten by the unreadable-save note). e2e [M3-2]: notice shown, main memory (seed + Marker) opens, main key still holds Marker.
main.ts: on a stamp change, stars only in the browser copy are kept in <key>.previous and a persistent toast names them with 'Download it'. e2e [M3-4].

memories.test.ts: BFS connectivity from the first star, unique labels, labels ≤ 32. Mutation check: a two-star island with a duplicate 'Trails' label fails U-memories-2 ('stars not connected to the rest').

Owner approved fixing Hearthwake: origin/hearthwake 503ce6e publishes by replacing only site/ entries, no force-push, 4 retries; dry-run on a fake gh-pages kept bent-light/ and constellation/. Skill publish step: never force, re-fetch and redo on rejection (4 tries).
